description: List the releases of an R3 project, newest first: number, date, who made it, note, size, which one is LIVE (what the public URL shows), pinned, and releases in the trash (restorable for 7 days). Also says whether the project has saved changes that are not live yet: saving does NOT change the live site; r3_publish_live does. Read-only. Needs the project:read right.
name: r3_release_list

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: List a project's releases
